description: Generate two profile-bio variants for one platform in the user's trained voice — A authority-focused, B curiosity-focused — and save them as a bio A/B test. Optionally pass the current bio to improve on. Uses one AI text action. Nothing is changed on the platform itself.

current_bio.description: The bio the user has now, to improve on.

platform.description: Platform the bio is for, e.g. twitter or linkedin.

name: generate_bio_variants
